intro.title: Free Google Chrome theme creator
intro.description: Choose images and colors, preview your design, and create a custom Chrome theme.

about.title: Create a Chrome theme with your own images and colors
about.description: Theme Builder is a free tool for customizing the Google Chrome frame, toolbar, tabs, and new tab page. See changes in a Chrome-style preview as you work, then download the finished theme as a ZIP file.

image.title: Choose background images
image.description: Add JPEG, PNG, or WebP images to each area. The new tab editor also lets you move, resize, rotate, and crop an image directly.

design.title: Adjust colors and layout
design.description: Set frame and toolbar colors, image alignment, and repeat behavior. Every change appears immediately in the Chrome-style preview.

download.title: Download and apply
download.description: Generate the theme ZIP when your design is ready. Extract it and load the folder from Chrome's extensions manager to apply the theme.

about.privacyTitle: Your images are processed in your browser
about.privacyDescription: Image decoding, editing, color extraction, and ZIP creation happen in your browser. Images are not uploaded to a server for theme creation. Theme Builder supports JPEG, PNG, and WebP files and applies size limits to keep the browser responsive.

free.question: Can I create a Chrome theme for free?
free.answer: Yes. Theme Builder is free to use and does not require an account.

privacy.question: Are my images sent to a server?
privacy.answer: No. Images used to build your theme are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to a server.

formats.question: Which image formats are supported?
formats.answer: JPEG, PNG, and WebP are supported. Images must be 10 MB or smaller, no more than 8192 px on either side, and no more than 40 million pixels.

apply.question: How do I apply the theme in Chrome?
apply.answer: Extract the downloaded ZIP, enable developer mode in Chrome's extensions manager, and load the extracted folder. You can also open the application guide from the top of this page.

errors.name-too-long: Keep the theme name to 75 characters or fewer.
errors.version-invalid: Use one to four dot-separated integers from 0 to 65535.
errors.color-invalid: One or more color values are invalid.
errors.generic: The ZIP could not be created. Please try again.

images.title: Images
images.positionDescription: Choose how the background image is positioned.
images.repeatDescription: Control how the background image tiles.
images.scaleDescription: Decide whether the background should cover the entire new tab page.
images.edgeDescription: Automatically apply commonly used colors from the image.

imageValidation.unsupported-type: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
imageValidation.file-too-large: Images must be 10 MB or smaller.
imageValidation.decode-failed: The image could not be read.
imageValidation.dimensions-too-large: Image dimensions must not exceed 8192 px.
imageValidation.too-many-pixels: Images must contain no more than 40 million pixels.
imageValidation.too-many-layers: The background editor supports up to 20 images.

ntpEdgeColor.applyChrome: Apply matching colors to frame and toolbar

ntpEditor.title: New tab background editor
ntpEditor.description: Drag an image to move it, use the corners to resize, the top handle to rotate, and the edges to crop. Use the panel for precise adjustments.

errors.loadExisting: Failed to load the current image.

accessExtensions.title: Open the extensions manager
accessExtensions.body: From Chrome's menu (three dots), choose Extensions → Manage extensions.

enableDeveloperMode.title: Enable developer mode
enableDeveloperMode.body: Turn on the "Developer mode" toggle in the top-right corner.

loadExtension.title: Load the theme
loadExtension.body: Drag and drop the downloaded files onto the Manage extensions page.

revertGuide.title: How to revert

openCustomize.title: Open Chrome customization
openCustomize.body: Click Customize Chrome from the new tab page.

revertGuide.footer: You can also reset the theme from Chrome settings > Appearance.
